implemented: Same-display BWM control protocol; per-client default read-only, explicit owner/resume, fail-closed owner loss and isolated peer authority.

Bounded queue is in the actual DesktopProtocol core, with resource lifetime serial, owner/client cancellation and idle execution. Pause acknowledgement leaves no future activation from that connection until resume.

NativeDesktopControl/PanelRuntime/RuntimeControl require correlated acknowledgement plus local process quiescence before skin/stop confirmation. Initial valid pending request retains its control owner; invalid metadata is not accepted because runtime was previously busy.
Provider disable/loss suspends local queues and withdraws views, permits withdrawal when own provider is absent, requires fresh acknowledgement after recreation, including recovery while paused.
One-second timeout, late ack rejected and new-revision retry, tested by stalling only the private fixture through its pipe, never user process signals.
Launcher --native-desktops checks only read-only diagnostic compatibility, never loads/enables/installs a plugin, and relies on actual Wayland handshake afterwards.
Qt generated init(nullptr) is not a deinitializer; proxy release/rebind/double-destruction regression fixed and checked with ASan.
limits: No live Hyprland frontend execution, plugin deployment/loading or daily panel activation. Protocol/core/Qt evidence does not certify compositor ABI, actions or visual rendering.
Barrier applies to one Wayland connection, not all clients or mutually exclusive normal BWM window/workspace transactions. No rollback of actions already applied.
Create/remove, complete menu capability gating, wrapping policy, special workspace filters, provider conflict preflight and daily authorities remain pending.
Fixture has no render surfaces and uses inherited private socketpairs; task delegates are test QtObjects, not painted original Task.qml.
ASan detect_leaks=0 does not certify leaks or uninstrumented KDE libraries.
Existing external-widget/KNS and manual session evidence are not rerun/expanded.
